content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the ICMR NIRWOH Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of ICMR NIRWOH to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICMR NIRWOH recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the ICMR NIRWOH recruitment is 05 October 2026. Ensure you apply well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Technical Support – III?
faq.answer: For Project Technical Support – III, you need a three-year graduate degree in Biotechnology, Zoology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Analytical Sciences, or Life Sciences with three years of experience, or a Post Graduate degree in Biological Sciences.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) and Project Technical Support – III posts is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) will receive a salary of Rs.72,800/- per month, which includes Rs.56,000/- plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening of applications followed by a physical interaction or an online interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, no application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the National Institute for Research on Women's Health located?
faq.answer: The National Institute for Research on Women's Health (ICMR NIRWOH) is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400012.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications are invited for online submission only. Offline applications will not be considered for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a project-based recruitment, meaning the positions are temporary and tied to specific research projects.
